name: MIT-BIH Supraventricular Arrhythmia Database
description: The MIT-BIH Supraventricular Arrhythmia Database (SVDB) is a foundational electrophysiology benchmark hosted on PhysioNet. Developed by Beth Israel Hospital and MIT, the collection contains 78 half-hour 2-lead ambulatory ECG recordings chosen specifically to supplement the original MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database with examples of challenging supraventricular arrhythmias. Capturing approximately 160,000 individual heartbeats sampled at 128 Hz per channel, the recordings exhibit supraventricular ectopic beats (atrial premature complexes, junctional premature complexes), atrial fibrillation, atrial flutter, and junctional rhythms, each annotated with beat-by-beat and rhythm-state labels.
